mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% for the past 3 months signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment rate above 4% in the next 3 months signals weakening labor market strength, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5-day returns occur despite UNRATE crossing above 4% threshold (p < 0.05 in a 3-month window).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) creates a positive feedback loop, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns not observed when both GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS show the expected trends (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) combined with falling FEDFUNDS signals a late-cycle expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns not observed during low inflation and falling FEDFUNDS periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strengthening labor market, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns occur despite UNRATE falling below 4.0% (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) coupled with constrained industrial production (INDPRO < previous month) signals demand-driven growth, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns not observed when GDPC1 rises and INDPRO does not (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS and falling unemployment rate signals post-shock recovery, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns not observed during post-shock recovery periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index exceeding 95.0 signals robust supply chain activity, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns occur despite INDPRO crossing above 95.0 (p < 0.05).
